infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NAVI uses the rear camera to identify supported objects and read visible text.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NAVI uses the microphone for hands-free voice commands.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: NAVI converts your spoken commands into actions on this device.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NAVI uses your location to create and follow walking routes.
